description: Wave 6D-2 read-only clean-room JIP LN 57.30 (+ JohnnyGuitarNVSE 528 where used) confirmed-match probes promoting spec-note hypotheses to observed evidence.

batches.title: Wave 6D-2 JIP LN / Lutana confirmed-match observed probes

probes.claim: Verify upstream #3757: GetCellFlag on WRLD (WastelandNV 0xDA726 and FreesideWorld 0x10BEEA with DATA bit 0 set via SetWorldspaceFlag), FLST (0x14B96), null 0, and CELL OOB flag -1/17.
probes.expected: Confirm whether GetCellFlag returns 0 on WRLD even when WRLD DATA bit 0 (Small World) is 1, and returns 0 on FLST/null/OOB.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d2p2_49_get_cell_flag_wrld_3757|wnv(wf=%g->%g,cf=%g->%g)|free(wf=%g,cf=%g)|fl=%g,null=%g|doc(0=%g,neg=%g,17=%g)" w0 w1 cfW0 cfW1 fr0 cfFr cfFl cfNull cfDoc0 cfDocNeg cfDoc17

probes.claim: Verify GetArmorAR/GetArmorDT, GetArmorClass/SetArmorClass (Light/Medium/Heavy + OOB 0/4; jip-records.md:161), GetArmorRCT/SetArmorRCT, and GetBipedModelList/SetBipedModelList (85 active mod calls; static audit SD-12).
probes.expected: Confirm Medium armor class = 2 on ArmorCombat, SetArmorClass bounds, SetArmorRCT round-trip, and whether SetBipedModelList validates FLST/ARMO and clears on null 0.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d2_09_armor_class_ar_dt_rct_biped|ar=%.1f,dt=%.1f|cls=%g,%g,%g|set=%g,%g,%g|rct=[%z]|bipl(0z=%g,set=%g,badEqFl=%g,badZ=%g,nullZ=%g)" arC dtC cL cM cH cL2 cL0 cL4 rct1 (b0 == 0) (bSet == rFl) (bBad == rFl) (bBad == 0) (bNull == 0)

probes.claim: Verify GetImpactDataTrait 8..15 on an impact with no DODT (BaseBallBatMetalImpact 0x6C666; jip-records-7.md:149), OOB trait 18, SetImpactDataSet wrong-type (Stimpak), and SetImpactMaterialType OOB (-1, 12).
probes.expected: Confirm decal fallback values (8,32,8,32,32,4,1,4) on no-DODT impact, SetImpactDataSet non-IPDS behavior, and SetImpactMaterialType clamping/refusal outside 0..11.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d2_12_impact_data_no_dodt_and_material|bat=%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,oob=%.0f|ids(badEq0=%g,badZ=%g)|mt=%g,%g,%g,%g" b8 b9 b12 b15 b18 (idsBad == ids0) (idsBad == 0) mt0 mt5 mt12 mtNeg

probes.claim: Verify GetWorldspaceParentWorldspace (FreesideWorld -> WastelandNV, WastelandNV -> 0), GetWorldspacePersistentCell, GetExteriorCell unloaded return, GetCellBuffered, and GetBufferedCells empty vs non-empty array types.
probes.expected: FreesideWorld parent = 000DA726; WastelandNV parent = 0; persistent cell non-zero; unloaded exterior cell = 0; current interior buffered = 1.

probes.expected: Confirm music path/dB round-trip and SetMusicState return values.

probes.claim: Verify strictly read-only GetNumericINISetting (17 active mod calls; static audit SD-12) and GetStringINISetting: iSize W/H:Display, case-insensitivity, missing key, missing colon, and string setting queried numerically.
probes.expected: Confirm iSize W/H > 0, case-insensitive match, missing key & missing colon return -1, and sLanguage:General returns ENGLISH via GetStringINISetting.

probes.claim: Verify GetImageSpaceTrait (traits 0, 21, OOB 33), GetImageSpaceModTrait (traits 0, 1, 2 radial blur center offset hypothesis, 64..67), and next-tick retention of duplicate entries in GetActiveIMODs (jip-world-12.md:59).
probes.expected: Verify IMAD traits 1/2/65..67 values and whether duplicate ApplyImageSpaceModifier entries survive onto the next tick in GetActiveIMODs.

probes.claim: Verify GetActorsByProcessingLevel (7 active mod calls; static audit SD-05) across levels 0,1,2,3,-1,4 — specifically whether Player (0x14) and DocMitchellRef (0x104C0F) are in level 0 — plus GetCombatStyle on Player, DocMitchellRef, and DocMitchell base.
probes.expected: NVForever omits Player (0x14) from GetActorsByProcessingLevel 0 because package_actors() only scans placed/created refs; probe checks exact membership & empty array sizes.

probes.expected: Confirm Boone mult=0.75, AddBaseEffectListEffect prepends once & rejects non-SPEL, and SetExcludedCombatActions masks to 27 bits.

probes.expected: Confirm SmallFrame entry 0 accepts valid SPEL and rejects Stimpak, FastShot entry 1 function=8, and GetPerkFlag ignores flag 3.
